title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 114
paragraphs: In this part of the battle the polemarch Callimachus was killed, having shown himself a brave man, and one of the generals, Stesilaus son of Thrasylaus, was killed too. Cynegirus son of Euphorion, as he was grasping the ornament at the stern of a ship, had his hand cut off with an axe and fell. Many other Athenians of distinction were also killed.
